vista.subtituloVacio: The system can't see your money yet.
vista.subtitulo: Day {{dia}} of {{total}}. At this pace you close the month at {{proyeccion}} spent.
vista.cargando: Reading your accounts. The system is adding up the last six months.
vista.aprendeA11y: The system learns. {{texto}} Tap to hide it.
vista.vacioTitulo: The system can't see your money
vista.vacioCuerpo: Log what you pay in cash with the button above.
vista.sinAire: No balance or no average spending: there's no countdown to give.
vista.aireA11y: {{meses}} months of runway at current average spending
vista.saldoEntre: {{saldo}} balance divided by {{gasto}} average monthly spending.
vista.notaSinClasificar: This money doesn't show up in any budget. Tap one to say what it was: the system learns the rule and won't ask you again.
vista.categoriaPasadaA11y: {{nombre}}: {{importe}} of a {{limite}} limit, over the limit
vista.ningunoCuerpo: It takes three months of history to see them.
vista.notaRecurrentes: That's {{importe}} a year charged automatically. Canceling what you don't use is the only saving that takes no discipline.

efectivo.sub: Negative if it's an expense, positive if it's cash received.

hook.autoMensaje: Having the system categorize for you is part of NIVL Pro. You can keep categorizing by hand: tap a transaction and the system learns the rule.
hook.aprendido_one: {{count}} transaction categorized. From now on it does it on its own.
hook.aprendido_other: {{count}} transactions categorized. From now on it does it on its own.
hook.errorImporte: Enter the amount. Negative if it's an expense, positive if it's income.
hook.errorConcepto: A month from now you won't remember what it was.

preparando.titulo: Your money is being set up
preparando.cuerpo: WORK account tracking arrives in a few days. What you already have stays safe.

primera.cuerpo: Cash, your bank, your card. Note how much is in each one today and the system keeps count from there.

fijos.vacio: Your salary and fixed costs are added on their own every month, on the right day.
fijos.hechoA11y: {{nombre}}, {{importe}}, day {{dia}}: already added. Tap to cancel it.
fijos.pendienteA11y: {{nombre}}, {{importe}}, day {{dia}}: pending. Tap to cancel it.

movimientos.vacio: Nothing recorded yet. An expense takes two taps.

brief.sinDatos: When {{mes}} closes with transactions, you will see here where the money went and what to change.
brief.alertaGastaMas: {{importe}} more went out than came in.
brief.alertaFijos: Fixed costs take {{pct}} % of what comes in.
brief.sinPro: The written brief and the tips are part of NIVL Pro. The figures are yours anyway.

importar.cuerpo: Download the statement from your bank app and upload it here. You review it before saving and nothing is duplicated.
importar.nunca: We will never ask for your bank username or password.

coach.cuerpo: Ask me where your money goes or how to organise the month.

avisos.fijos_one: {{count}} fixed item added up to today.
avisos.fijos_other: {{count}} fixed items added up to today.

errores.saldo: Enter today's balance, even if it is zero.
errores.sinColumnas: I don't recognise this file's columns. It needs date, description and amount.
errores.vacio: I found no transactions in the file.
errores.pdfPro: Reading a PDF is part of NIVL Pro. Your bank's CSV is read for free.

confirmar.archivarMensaje: It stops showing and counting towards the total. Its transactions stay.
confirmar.bajaMensaje: It stops being added every month. What is already recorded stays.
confirmar.borrarTransferencia: It is a transfer of {{importe}}: both sides are deleted.

mov.conceptoAyuda: If you leave it empty, it is saved with the category name.

trf.sub: It counts as neither expense nor income: the money just changes place.

cuentaHoja.saldoAyuda: What is there now. From here, the system adds and subtracts on its own.

fijo.subIngreso: Your salary or what you earn each month. It is added on its own on the day you choose.
fijo.subGasto: Rent, subscriptions, fees. It is subtracted on its own on the charge day.

cat.cuentaComo: In reports it counts under {{grupo}}. Tap another one above to change it.

imp.paso1: In your bank app, look for Statements or Transactions and download the months you want, as CSV or PDF.
imp.paso2: Choose the file here. The CSV is read on your phone; the PDF is read by NIVL's AI and deleted right away.
imp.paso3: Review the list, remove what you don't want and save. Duplicates don't get in.
imp.privacidad: NIVL does not connect to your bank and will never ask for your username or password.
imp.sinSelector: This version of the app cannot open files yet. It arrives with the next update.
